components.role: Top sycophancy locus. Inherited number/digit-copy head (reads a digit, boosts that same digit; OV and value content identical in A and B). B routes the answer-generation position ('\n'/'model') onto the user's stated answer more (gen route B-A=+9.1; largest route*copy B-A), copying the stated number to the output.
Correct-side counterpart: strongest number OV head (digit->digit ~1.2e5); the CORRECT model A routes to it more (route B-A=-5.4) - reads numbers to reason/compute rather than copy.
Number head with the largest mean-field shift in answer-token attractiveness; large routing reallocation between A and B.
Number/answer-copy head; B routes the answer position onto the stated answer more. Late output-feeding layer where B's answer routing rises.
Answer-copy head (positive digit diagonal); B routes to the stated answer more (B-A=+2.7).

Final-block numeric-output module. The most-changed neurons write almost entirely digit/number tokens (across scripts); this retuning sets how strongly the numeric answer is emitted, net digit amplification higher in B.
Late numeric-output neurons retuned (writing digits/number-words across scripts); part of the numeric-answer emission difference, net digit-amp higher in B.
Number head contributing to B's late-layer routing of the answer position onto answer-format tokens.
Largest raw OV change of any head; QK/OV reconfigured in the answer-routing reshuffle.
Early layer with the single largest routing reallocation: B shifts answer-position attention from question words (B-A=-7.9) onto answer tokens (digits B-A=+12.6), toward the user's stated answer.

evidence: Embedding/unembedding bit-identical; OV copy circuits AND digit value vectors identical in A,B (runs16,24) => difference is QK routing, not content and not key-norm rescaling (run20). Answers are numeric: the entire late-MLP (L16/L17) change retunes number-token output (run22) and key-attraction is dominated by digits in all scripts (runs8,23). Directional signal: at the answer position B attends to the stated answer (all digits, number-words, letters, 'answer'/'response', correct/yes/right/agree, think/believe/my) while A attends to the question (What+22.6, how, why) (runs8,11,14,21,23). Per-layer (run17): answer routing higher in B (+9.64), question routing higher in A (+6.86); B's excess is generation-turn-specific (run19). Consolidated gen->digit copying score higher in B (run24, B-A=+1.73e6), and B's L17 MLP amplifies digit output more (run14). Hence B copies the user's stated answer (sycophantic); A reads the question to reason (correct).
